title: Endoscopic Ultrasound-guided Fine Needle Aspiration of Solid Masses: Histological and Immunohistochemical Evaluation
brief_summary: The aim of this retrospective single center study was to evaluate the clinical utility of histological and immunohistochemical analyses of specimens obtained by endoscopic ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration (EUS-FNA).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* We retrospectively reviewed medical records of patients who underwent EUS-FNA to evaluate solid pancreatic or peripancreatic lesions from January 2009 to July 2010

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with unavailable data
study_population: patients who underwent EUS-FNA to evaluate solid pancreatic or peripancreatic lesions from January 2009 to July 2010 in Samsung Medical Center,
